about.intro: GIVID is a multi-service company based in Malabo, Equatorial Guinea, focused on offering comprehensive solutions to businesses, institutions, individuals and event organizers.
about.whoText: Our activity is organized around three main areas: professional cleaning, maintenance and space care (GIVID Facility Services); hostess, event organization and equipment services (GIVID Events); and wholesale distribution of essential and cleaning goods (GIVID Distribution). As part of our growth strategy, we are also developing our own line of consumer products: rice, flour, diapers and wipes. From Equatorial Guinea, we work with an open, international outlook, ready to provide our services anywhere in the world our clients and partners need us.
about.whoTextRich: GIVID combines cleaning and maintenance, hostesses and events, and wholesale distribution in a single trusted company, with a close-knit team that knows the Equatorial Guinea market.
about.missionText: To offer comprehensive, quality solutions that meet our clients' needs, combining professional services, personalized attention and essential goods, with a firm commitment to excellence, trust and customer satisfaction.
about.visionText: To be a reference company in Equatorial Guinea and to establish ourselves as a business group with international reach, recognized for the quality of our services, the excellence of our products, the strength of our business relationships and our ability to generate value in the markets where we operate.
about.storyTitle: Committed to your growth, without the hassle
about.storySubtitle: We bring cleaning and maintenance, hostesses and events, and wholesale distribution together under one trusted company. Focus on your business — we'll handle the rest.
about.historyText: GIVID was born in Equatorial Guinea with a clear idea: to build a company capable of offering practical, professional, quality solutions for the needs of businesses, institutions and individuals.
about.historyExtra1: From the start, we committed to a diversified business model, developing different areas of activity that let us support our clients across the various aspects of their needs.
about.historyExtra2: Our activity began with a focus on professional services and, over time, we expanded our capabilities into events and the wholesale commercialization and distribution of essential goods.
about.historyExtra3: As part of our growth, we also developed GIVID, our own product line, adding categories such as rice, flour, diapers and wipes.
about.historyExtra4: Today we keep working to build a solid, dynamic company ready to take on new challenges, expand our offering and establish lasting business relationships inside and outside Equatorial Guinea.
about.historyQuote: Our story is, above all, one of growth, learning and a vision for the future. And this is only the beginning.
about.fromGuineaTitle: From Equatorial Guinea to new markets
about.fromGuineaText: Our headquarters are at C/ Timbabe, next to Hotel Timbabe, Malabo, Bioko Norte, Equatorial Guinea, where we run our activity and build our international reach. Our ambition is to keep growing and bring our services and solutions wherever our clients and business partners need them.
about.whyGividIntro: At GIVID we believe a good business relationship is built on three pillars: quality, trust and commitment. We work to understand each client's needs in order to offer tailored, efficient and professional solutions.
about.whyGivid1Text: We bring together different services under one company: facility services, maintenance, green spaces, events, hostesses, event equipment and distribution of essential goods.
about.whyGivid2Text: We care about every detail of our services and select our products aiming to deliver an experience that meets our clients' expectations.
about.whyGivid3Text: Every client and every project is different. That's why we adapt the way we work to the specific features and needs of each service.
about.whyGivid4Text: We work to build lasting business relationships based on reliability, responsibility and transparency.
about.whyGivid5Text: Our multi-service structure lets us respond to different needs and offer practical solutions from a single point of contact.
about.whyGivid6Text: From Equatorial Guinea, we work with an outlook open to the world and a drive to grow and expand into new markets.
about.whyGividQuote: GIVID: a company where our clients find solutions, professionalism and trust.
about.valuesSubtitle: At GIVID we understand that a company is built not only through its services and products, but also through the way it works and the relationships it forms.
about.value1Text: We get involved in every project and take our responsibilities seriously and with dedication.
about.value2Text: We work with discipline, organization and attention to detail to deliver quality services.
about.value3Text: We build lasting relationships based on transparency, respect and keeping our commitments.
about.value4Text: We continuously look to improve our processes, services and products to deliver maximum value to our clients.
about.value5Text: We listen, understand and respond to our clients' needs, offering solutions tailored to each situation.
about.value6Text: We stay open to new ideas, products, services and ways of working that let us evolve.
about.value7Text: We act responsibly towards our clients, staff, suppliers and the environment in which we operate.
about.value8Text: We have the drive to grow, develop new opportunities and take our experience and services beyond our borders.
about.valuesQuote: Our values aren't just what we say. They're how we choose to do business.

distribution.overviewExtra: We work with shops, restaurants, hotels, institutions and individuals who need a steady, reliable supply. We manage every order directly, without intermediaries, to offer you the best possible price and availability.
distribution.quote: We don't distribute to fill a warehouse: we distribute so you never run out of the essentials.
distribution.faqQ1: Do you deliver, or only sell in-store?
distribution.faqA1: We handle orders directly: you can collect from our store in Timbabe, Malabo, or ask us about delivery depending on volume and area.
distribution.faqQ2: Is there a minimum order for wholesale purchases?
distribution.faqA2: We don't have a fixed published minimum: we work with businesses buying by the pallet and individuals buying by the sack or box. Message us and we'll tell you the best option for your volume.
distribution.faqA3: The prices shown in the catalog are indicative. For large or recurring orders, contact us and we'll prepare a proposal with the best terms.
distribution.faqQ4: Who distributes wholesale products in Equatorial Guinea?
distribution.faqA4: GIVID Distribution sells food, water, childcare and household cleaning products at wholesale prices in Malabo, including our own GIVID brand. We manage orders directly, without intermediaries, for shops, distributors, institutions and individuals across Equatorial Guinea.

facilityServices.overviewExtra: We don't just provide a cleaning service. We aim to become a trusted partner for the upkeep and care of our clients' facilities, letting them focus on their core business while we take care of their spaces.
facilityServices.process1Text: We visit your facilities and assess what you need: frequency, scope and type of service.
facilityServices.process2Text: We prepare a tailored proposal with the right staff, products and schedule.
facilityServices.process3Text: Our team takes care of everything on a recurring basis, with follow-up and adjustments whenever you need them.
facilityServices.quote: We take care of your spaces. You focus on growing.
facilityServices.faqQ1: How often is the cleaning done?
facilityServices.faqA1: It depends on each facility: it can be daily, several times a week, or a one-off service. We define it together during the initial assessment, based on the type of space and its use.
facilityServices.faqQ2: Do you work outside business hours?
facilityServices.faqA2: Yes, whenever possible we schedule cleaning outside your working hours so it doesn't interfere with your day-to-day business.
facilityServices.faqQ3: Is garden and green space maintenance included?
facilityServices.faqA3: Caring for green spaces is one of our service lines. You can hire it together with building cleaning or on its own.

events.overviewExtra: We adapt our services to the specifics of each event, from congresses, conferences, trade fairs and product launches to openings, receptions, dinners, weddings and private celebrations. We also offer complementary equipment solutions, including rental of elegant tables and chairs, so clients can cover several needs with a single provider.
events.process1Text: Date, type of event, number of guests, and what you need: hostesses, furniture, or both.
events.process2Text: We send you a quote, assigned staff and furniture plan, tailored to your event.
events.process3Text: Our team arrives early, sets up the furniture and looks after your guests with professionalism.
events.quote: We take care of every detail so your event becomes a memorable experience.
events.faqQ1: How far in advance should I book hostesses or furniture?
events.faqA1: The sooner the better, especially on high-demand dates. Even so, send us your date and we'll do our best to accommodate your event.
events.faqQ2: Do you handle setup and teardown of the furniture?
events.faqA2: Yes, our team handles setup before the event and collection of the furniture afterwards.
events.faqQ3: How many people can I rent tables and chairs for?
events.faqA3: We adapt to both small events and large gatherings. Tell us the number of guests and we'll propose the amount of furniture you need.
